newsitem.title: USA: PDC at midpoint of Q1 drilling program.
newsitem.headline: PDC at midpoint of Q1 drilling program.

text.p: Petroleum Development Corp said it has completed drilling 44 wells in its first quarter 1997 drilling program, about half of the number planned for the quarter.
The total includes 23 wells in Pennsylvania, eight wells in West Virginia, and 13 wells on the company's recently acquired Michigan Antrim acreage.
Of the 44 wells drilled, all have been completed or scheduled for completion, and none will be plugged and abandoned. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
